tiers.name: Unconstrained Top-8 Routing + Flat 64-Rank AllToAllv (BF16)
tiers.note: Each token scatters to ~7.12 nodes over 50 GB/s RDMA in BF16 (6.85 ms/layer), far exceeding the 2.3 ms MLP compute window!

tiers.name: M=4 Node-Limited Routing + Naive Flat 64-Rank ncclAllToAllv
tiers.note: Restricts experts to <=4 nodes, but flat AllToAllv still sends separate RDMA packets to GPU 1 and GPU 5 on the same remote node (zero RDMA savings)!

tiers.name: M=4 Node-Limited + 2-Stage Hierarchical RDMA->NVLink Deduplicated Dispatch (BF16)
tiers.note: Sends only 1 deduplicated copy per target node over RDMA (3.12 copies/tok, 2.28x less RDMA) and fans out over 900 GB/s intra-node NVLink.

tiers.name: M=4 + DeepEP 2-Stage RDMA->NVLink Dedup + FP8 Dispatch / BF16 Combine (IBGDA)
tiers.note: Combines M=4 node deduplication (3.12 copies) with FP8 (1B) dispatch + BF16 combine and IBGDA overlap -> 1.42 ms (4.82x faster, 100% hidden under compute)!
